title: Convert Temp Buildings to Spatial Assets
description: Convert the temporary building data into spatial asset JSON once. Focus on producing correct JSON assets and avoid broader code changes.
summary: Converted temp building BREP JSON payloads into spatial topology fixture JSON assets. Generated small, tall, and large building topology files with mesh surface data wrapped in schema-valid face/shell/cell/cellComplex/cluster records. Validated JSON syntax, core parser hydration, triangle indices, and topology schema shape.
